mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[coverage:run]
branch = False
# `taskq_plus/__main__.py` is the dedicated `python -m taskq_plus`
# entry-point module: its only executable body is the
# `if __name__ == "__main__":` guard, which by construction never runs
# under an import-based test harness. Per the Gate 1 pragma policy an
# entry-point module is excluded at FILE level here rather than being
# annotated with `# pragma: no cover` inline.
omit =
    03-development/src/taskq_plus/__main__.py
    */taskq_plus/__main__.py

[tool:pytest]
# The harness's mutation-test workdir only copies setup.cfg (not pytest.ini),
# so the framework's promotion (mutation_enforcer.py:388-424) rewrites this
# entry to an absolute path that pytest can resolve inside its temp dir.
# Without it mutmut's baseline test-suite run fails collection with
# `ModuleNotFoundError: taskq_plus` because no `from taskq_plus...` import
# can be resolved at collection time.
#

test_coverage::pytest.ini.head:
[pytest]
# The harness vendored under `harness/` carries its own test suite
# (`harness/tests/`) which imports `harness_cli` and crashes on
# Python <3.10 with `SystemExit(1)`. When the gate's cross-validation
# invokes `pytest {root}` for `pytest-benchmark` (or any test-family
# tool that takes the project root as a path), pytest would otherwise
# discover the harness tests alongside the project tests and abort
# collection. Keep the harness suite out of root-level pytest runs.
# Explicit `-p pytest_benchmark` is REQUIRED: the mutation-testing
# framework (mutation_enforcer.py:494) sets PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1
# in mutmut's subprocess env, and only re-enables xdist/pytest_cov based
# on the resolved runner. Without this, the baseline test-suite run
# errors every benchmark with "fixture 'benchmark' not found" and
# mutmut reports score=null. Loading the plugin here is harmless for
# non-benchmark tests — pytest-benchmark only triggers on the fixture.
addopts =
    --ignore=harness/tests
    --ignore=harness/tests-cli
    -p benchmark
# `taskq_plus` lives under `03-development/src`; without this pytest
